label: Accessible uniqueness of concrete GOD_4 when one exists at the standpoint
term: accessible uniqueness of concrete GOD_4 when present at the standpoint
definition: GodPresenceUniqueWhenPresentAt σ m w: if some concrete GOD_4 exists at w, then for every world v accessible from w, any two concrete GOD_4 existing at v are identical. It asserts no existence.
note: The certified difference of rigidity over persistence (#1598): rigidity holds exactly when persistence and this condition hold (rigidOverPersistsExact, no background). It is the cross-world uniqueness content that the modal ontological route does not use. Analyst formulation, attribution deferred.
